Description: Eurovision Song Contest 2021 semi-final 1: each of the five anonymous jurors (A-E) in every national jury ranks all songs in the show except their own country's; 16 songs, 95 jurors with a ranking (of 95 juror slots across 19 juries). One row per juror x song; item = performing country's ISO code (songs are not people, so the label is kept), resp = rank given (1 = best); cov_jury_country = voting country, cov_juror = letter. Rankings layout (irw_rankings family, data/rankings/README.md).
Reference: Burgoyne, J. A., Spijkervet, J., & Baker, D. J. (2023). Measuring the Eurovision Song Contest: A living dataset for real-world MIR. Proceedings of ISMIR 2023. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10265412
Notes: Script data/rankings/eurovision_jurors.py (MIRoVision data/CSV/jurors.csv, commit d70e25d, compiled from the per-juror breakdowns the EBU publishes on eurovision.tv since 2016). Design record data/rankings/design_tables.csv. Under 100 rankers; admitted under the rankings floor of 50 (README, Intake rules).
